next_packet_queue.scope: Required next reference-seek work; synchronization now has exact C transport behavior. The indexed seek implementation is not fixed.
required_packet_behavior: Reuse SyncedPage/SyncReader so probe offsets can find captures inside packet payloads and obey cached/byte-boundary behavior.
Add a separate reference packet queue alongside strict Demuxer/PacketCapture. Match pagein, packetpeek and packetout with unmodified libogg.
Initial stream init uses pageno zero; reset uses signed C-long -1 sentinel. Sequence wrap and the sentinel differ by host C-long width; test both ordinary values and boundaries.
A missing initial continuation is skipped without a packet number increment. Holes increment packet numbers when consumed, including packetpeek on a hole.
Sequence gaps remove pending partial data. Continued pages discard unavailable fragments. Preserve lacing/granule placement and source packet counts exactly.
When sequence matches, a missing continued flag does not discard an existing partial packet: libogg can merge new laces into it. Strict continuation validation must stay separate.
EOS marks the last currently queued lacing entry, including a nil EOS page when older queued data remains. EOS and completion are separate state.
Keep raw version/flag transport fields. Reference stream pagein rejects unsupported versions/serial mismatch, while strict parsing still rejects reserved flags.
Combine reference queues and synthesis with exact large page bisection, raw-seek continuation fallback, header-only initial offsets, link changes, track-only preroll and signed file PCM cursors.

Probe rejected long-mode window prefixes in track-only seek loops: vorbisfile ignores the track return and inserts the retained/partially changed block descriptor. Establish defined observable behavior before implementing that path.

Close all 172 indexed seek differences with fresh exact statuses, clocks, positions and counts; retain original PCM tolerances. Add large searches, continuation pages, competing serials, chains and repeated/partial reads.
